description: Defines the template class ExclusivelyOwned, a smart-pointer-like wrapper for exclusively owned objects of type T, with associated traits and methods for managing ownership, destruction, and access.

classes.name: ExclusivelyOwned
classes.description: A smart-pointer-like wrapper for an exclusively-owned instance of type T, providing ownership management and access methods.

methods.name: ExclusivelyOwned()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to null representation.

methods.name: ExclusivelyOwned(T&& t)
methods.description: Constructs with an rvalue reference to T, moving it into the representation.

methods.name: ExclusivelyOwned(std::in_place_t, Args&&... args)
methods.description: Constructs in place with provided arguments.

methods.name: operator=(ExclusivelyOwned&& rhs)
methods.description: Move assignment operator, destroys current owned object and takes ownership from rhs.

methods.name: operator=(T&& rhs)
methods.description: Assigns a new owned object by moving from rhs.

methods.name: ~ExclusivelyOwned()
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the owned object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the owned object.
